brief:
Mahmoud Khalil, a Columbia University graduate, filed a federal civil complaint against the institution and SIPA Dean Keren Yarhi-Milo alleging persistent discrimination against Palestinians, Drop Site News reported. The lawsuit invokes Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, which prohibits discrimination based on national origin at federally funded institutions.

Khalil filed the complaint alongside other graduates, targeting what they characterize as systemic anti-Palestinian bias within the university's policies and practices. The case centers on alleged violations at Columbia's School of International and Public Affairs.
dek: Khalil and other graduates filed a federal civil complaint accusing Columbia University and SIPA Dean Keren Yarhi-Milo of Title VI violations.
title: Columbia graduate sues university over anti-Palestinian discrimination
